Class EndGameBuildingCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.buildings.BuildingCard
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.buildings.EndGameBuildingCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Card, Serializable
public class EndGameBuildingCard extends BuildingCard
Represents a building card that awards additional prestige points at the end of the game, dynamically calculated based on a specific rule or condition related to the player's inventory.
